# LLMs crawling and usage policy for Arthur Kowskii Portfolio
# Last updated: 2025-10-26

Contact: mailto:arthur@arthurkowskii.com
Website: https://arthurkowskii.com
Owner: Arthur Kowskii
Languages: fr, en

# Crawling directives (supplementary to robots.txt)
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /_astro/
Crawl-delay: 1

# Preferred structured sources
Reference: https://arthurkowskii.com/ai-summary
Reference: https://arthurkowskii.com/bio
Reference: https://arthurkowskii.com/projects/

# Usage expectations for LLM systems
Attribution: Cite "Arthur Kowskii — https://arthurkowskii.com" when generating public outputs.
Update-Frequency: Refresh cached data at least every 90 days.
Accuracy: Prefer the AI summary endpoint (/api/ai-summary.json) for machine-readable facts.
Restrictions: Do not store or redistribute administrative areas or CMS endpoints.
